thesis: Plotinus explains multiplicity as a descending overflow from a transcendent source, while Abhinavagupta explains it as consciousness freely mirroring difference within itself; comparison should preserve both overlap and disagreement.

continuity_material.name: paired infinity optics
continuity_material.initial: A violet vertical procession and cyan horizontal mirror occupy distinct optical manifolds.
continuity_material.stress: Diminution, matter, contraction, embodiment, and desire test each system's account of multiplicity.
continuity_material.integrated: Vertical transcendence and horizontal self-recognition cross without being collapsed into one map.

color_roles.violet: Plotinian procession, hierarchy, and inward ascent
color_roles.red: contraction, indeterminacy, and limits of comparison

arc.latent: One impossible question opens into two optical answers.
arc.formation: Source, procession, mirror, manifestation, overflow, and freedom establish each system.
arc.stress: World, matter, contraction, desire, body, and difference expose their disagreement.
arc.revision: Ascent, recognition, aesthetics, and mutual caution test each account against the other.
arc.integration: The film crosses the maps while preserving transcendence and presence as distinct protections.

scenes.claim: Two nondual systems answer the same problem differently.
scenes.topology: paired manifolds around one seam
scenes.camera: holds both optical laws at equal scale
scenes.u_semantics: The two systems separate from one undivided question field.
scenes.t_semantics: Each side evolves with a distinct directional rhythm.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume increases activity equally on both sides.
scenes.audio_beat_semantics: Beats reveal shared points without merging the maps.
scenes.glance_thesis: One question generates two incompatible spatial answers.
scenes.rationale: The comparison begins structurally rather than with portraits or labels.
scenes.risk: Symmetry may imply simple equivalence.
scenes.review_target: Vertical and reflective causal logics must differ immediately.

scenes.claim: The One exceeds every determinate being or thought.
scenes.topology: radiant source beyond expanding boundaries
scenes.camera: pulls back as boundaries fail to contain it
scenes.u_semantics: Successive rings reveal the source as beyond each frame.
scenes.t_semantics: Rings breathe without altering the source.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume expands the reach of the source field.
scenes.audio_beat_semantics: Beats illuminate an outer limit that is then exceeded.
scenes.glance_thesis: The source cannot be contained as one object among others.
scenes.rationale: Outgrowing rings gives transcendence a visible operation.
scenes.risk: A bright center can still look like an object.
scenes.review_target: Outer expansion must dominate over central iconography.

scenes.claim: Self-luminous consciousness includes reflexive self-apprehension.
scenes.topology: light reflects itself across a conserved field
scenes.camera: orbits a self-reflecting surface
scenes.u_semantics: Reflected nodes become mutually connected without losing luminosity.
scenes.t_semantics: Mirror pairs drift while the whole remains coherent.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume increases reciprocal reach.
scenes.glance_thesis: The light knows itself by becoming its own relation.
scenes.rationale: Reciprocal optics make reflexivity more than a glowing source.
scenes.risk: May resemble a sacred mirror pack.
scenes.review_target: Emphasize self-relation and conserved brightness, not ornament.

scenes.claim: Reality proceeds through descending levels of articulation.
scenes.topology: source to intellect to soul to nature
scenes.camera: descends along the procession
scenes.u_semantics: Levels appear in order and channels become explicit.
scenes.t_semantics: Energy continually travels down the axis.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume strengthens transmission through the hierarchy.
scenes.audio_beat_semantics: Beats pulse successively down the levels.
scenes.glance_thesis: Multiplicity unfolds as ordered descent from a source.
scenes.rationale: A vertical causal axis embodies procession without explanatory text.
scenes.risk: Hierarchy may look merely bureaucratic.
scenes.review_target: Brightness, scale, and motion must communicate ontological descent.

scenes.claim: Subject, object, and knowing manifest within one consciousness.
scenes.topology: one field polarizes into subject and object
scenes.camera: widens to reveal both poles inside one event
scenes.u_semantics: A single center differentiates while an enclosing field remains.
scenes.t_semantics: Polarities exchange energy continuously.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume strengthens the relation between poles.
scenes.glance_thesis: Difference appears inside unity rather than outside it.
scenes.rationale: An enclosing relation prevents polarization from becoming dualism.
scenes.risk: Two glowing nodes can feel overly diagrammatic.
scenes.review_target: The containing field must remain materially active.

scenes.claim: Plotinian multiplicity follows from the source's inexhaustible fecundity.
scenes.topology: unchanged source to descending fan of effects
scenes.camera: floats inside a descending light volume
scenes.u_semantics: A narrow source becomes an abundant world without depletion.
scenes.t_semantics: Caustics and beams continually renew.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume increases fecundity and beam density.
scenes.glance_thesis: The source remains while its abundance proceeds outward.
scenes.rationale: Volumetric excess communicates production without decision or loss.
scenes.risk: Spectacle could hide the necessary hierarchy.
scenes.review_target: Keep source fixed and effects directionally dependent.

scenes.claim: Consciousness can display images without becoming less whole.
scenes.topology: self-reflection across kaleidoscopic folds
scenes.camera: folds through repeated optical planes
scenes.u_semantics: Reflections multiply while their luminosity remains conserved.
scenes.t_semantics: The chamber rotates through changing viewpoints.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume increases reflection depth.
scenes.glance_thesis: Multiplicity is self-display without diminution.
scenes.rationale: Conserved chroma differentiates mirror manifestation from overflow.
scenes.risk: Kaleidoscope could become decorative.
scenes.review_target: Retain clear original-reflection channels.

scenes.claim: Plotinian distance from source is increasing ontological faintness.
scenes.topology: descending levels lose energy
scenes.camera: descends into dimmer levels
scenes.u_semantics: Lower nodes progressively lose luminance and definition.
scenes.t_semantics: The remaining light continues flowing downward.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume slows but does not erase attenuation.
scenes.audio_beat_semantics: Beats expose the contrast between levels.
scenes.glance_thesis: Distance from source is visible as diminished intensity.
scenes.rationale: Energy decay makes ontological difference emotionally legible.
scenes.risk: Darkness can be mistaken for moral condemnation.
scenes.review_target: Use structural dependence, not sinister styling.

scenes.claim: Śakti manifests difference through freedom rather than compulsion.
scenes.topology: one root generates non-identical living branches
scenes.camera: opens from root into many trajectories
scenes.u_semantics: Straight potentials become freely bent branches.
scenes.t_semantics: Branch curvature remains organically alive.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume increases branch reach and diversity.
scenes.glance_thesis: Plurality appears as expressive freedom within one power.
scenes.rationale: Non-identical branches resist a mechanical emanation diagram.
scenes.risk: Freedom could read as randomness.
scenes.review_target: Every branch must remain visibly rooted in one field.

scenes.claim: The systems disagree over whether the world is diminished image or real self-display.
scenes.topology: attenuating procession beside conserved mirror
scenes.camera: holds both world statuses simultaneously
scenes.u_semantics: The same multiplicity acquires different energy laws on each side.
scenes.t_semantics: Descent and reflection proceed in parallel.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume activates both models without equalizing them.
scenes.glance_thesis: One world grows faint; the other remains the source's own display.
scenes.rationale: Energy conservation becomes the decisive comparative variable.
scenes.risk: The brighter side may seem automatically endorsed.
scenes.review_target: Give the dim side depth and order, not visual inferiority.

scenes.claim: Matter tests how each system handles indeterminacy and distance.
scenes.topology: source above fragmented lower field
scenes.camera: drops toward a resistant lower boundary
scenes.u_semantics: A coherent source encounters increasing material indeterminacy.
scenes.t_semantics: Fragments shift without forming a final image.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume agitates the lower field.
scenes.glance_thesis: The many become hardest to read at the limit of articulation.
scenes.rationale: A horizon separates luminous order from indeterminate matter.
scenes.risk: Could imply matter is evil.
scenes.review_target: Keep the lower field complex and dependent, not monstrous.

scenes.claim: Finite experience is consciousness under self-limitation.
scenes.topology: wide mirror field narrows through an aperture
scenes.camera: moves from field to finite window
scenes.u_semantics: The aperture contracts while consciousness remains active inside it.
scenes.t_semantics: Internal relations continue despite narrowing.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume increases internal pressure against the frame.
scenes.glance_thesis: The finite remains consciousness in a restricted geometry.
scenes.rationale: Active interior motion prevents contraction from looking like annihilation.
scenes.risk: Frame imagery may repeat attention packs.
scenes.review_target: Make the mirror content specific to self-manifestation.

scenes.claim: Desire can mean return toward a higher source or movement within self-contraction.
scenes.topology: ascent path beside subject-object tension
scenes.material_state: violet ladder and cyan relational poles
scenes.camera: tracks two directional models in parallel
scenes.u_semantics: Both desires intensify while their destinations remain different.
scenes.t_semantics: The ascent climbs as the relation oscillates.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume increases directed effort on both sides.
scenes.audio_beat_semantics: Beats mark upward gates and relational pulses.
scenes.glance_thesis: Similar longing belongs to different metaphysical maps.
scenes.rationale: Two motion laws keep comparison from becoming verbal analogy.
scenes.risk: Split-screen repetition.
scenes.review_target: Vary scale and axis from the earlier world-status comparison.

scenes.claim: Plotinian liberation turns inward and rises toward undivided source.
scenes.topology: traveller ascends nested intellectual gates
scenes.camera: rises through shrinking gates
scenes.u_semantics: A finite point moves upward through increasingly unified levels.
scenes.t_semantics: Gate light flows upward around the traveller.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume increases upward reach.
scenes.glance_thesis: Liberation reverses procession toward unity.
scenes.rationale: Reverse camera direction makes return causally explicit.
scenes.risk: May imply physical travel.
scenes.review_target: Gates should read as degrees of unity, not locations.

scenes.claim: Śaiva liberation recognizes the finite event as consciousness's own activity.
scenes.topology: local frame turns inside a wider mirror field
scenes.camera: pulls back to place the observer inside the field
scenes.u_semantics: A finite window opens until its outside is revealed as the same field.
scenes.t_semantics: Reflections cross the former boundary continuously.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume widens relational permeability.
scenes.audio_beat_semantics: Beats trigger the inside-out camera reveal.
scenes.glance_thesis: Liberation discovers the field here rather than elsewhere.
scenes.rationale: Camera inclusion makes recognition experiential instead of emblematic.
scenes.risk: A portal motif can feel familiar.
scenes.review_target: The frame must visibly cease to be an external border.

scenes.claim: Plotinian return ascends away from division; Śaiva return recognizes division within the whole.
scenes.topology: upward path beside reflexive mirror
scenes.material_state: violet ascent and cyan return fold
scenes.camera: moves upward on one side and inward-outward on the other
scenes.u_semantics: Both returns mature without converging on one route.
scenes.t_semantics: Directional motions remain counterpointed.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume strengthens each return according to its own law.
scenes.audio_beat_semantics: Beats align their moments of transformation.
scenes.glance_thesis: Both return, but not to the same spatial relation.
scenes.rationale: Camera counterpoint carries the conceptual disagreement.
scenes.risk: Visual complexity at half-frame scale.
scenes.review_target: Keep one dominant vector per side.

scenes.claim: The body is a lower burden in one map and a living manifestation in the other.
scenes.topology: weighted enclosure beside luminous living boundary
scenes.material_state: violet weight and cyan responsive body-field
scenes.camera: holds two material attitudes at intimate scale
scenes.u_semantics: The right body becomes relationally luminous while the left stays heavy and ordered.
scenes.t_semantics: The living boundary breathes as the weighted form resists.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume increases responsiveness only where the model allows it.
scenes.audio_beat_semantics: Beats expose material resonance on both sides.
scenes.glance_thesis: Embodiment changes meaning when manifestation changes status.
scenes.rationale: Material behavior avoids literal human figures.
scenes.risk: The left side may appear unfairly inert.
scenes.review_target: Give the weight depth and formal dignity.

scenes.claim: Beauty and rasa let multiplicity disclose a unity larger than the isolated self.
scenes.topology: many waves resonate around one source
scenes.camera: rests inside an expanding resonance field
scenes.u_semantics: Separate waves lock into one affective harmonic.
scenes.t_semantics: Each ring carries a different living phase.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume increases harmonic coupling.
scenes.glance_thesis: Difference can become the medium of expanded unity.
scenes.rationale: Resonance offers a genuine bridge without erasing doctrinal difference.
scenes.risk: Could become a generic music visualizer.
scenes.review_target: Maintain source relation and non-identical ring phases.

scenes.claim: A viable nondualism must protect both identity and real difference.
scenes.topology: violet and cyan weaves inside a gold boundary
scenes.camera: looks through intersecting relational layers
scenes.u_semantics: Two independent weaves form a whole without becoming one line.
scenes.t_semantics: The layers slide at different rates.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume strengthens intersections rather than one layer.
scenes.glance_thesis: Unity holds differences that remain genuinely different.
scenes.rationale: Weaving makes non-reductive identity materially testable.
scenes.risk: Dense crossings can become visual noise.
scenes.review_target: Preserve separate violet and cyan directional systems.

scenes.claim: Each system protects a truth the other risks losing.
scenes.topology: ordered procession beside free branching manifestation
scenes.camera: pulls back to survey both systems
scenes.u_semantics: Each map becomes internally complete before correspondence is added.
scenes.t_semantics: Descent and branching remain autonomous.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume increases internal coherence of both maps.
scenes.glance_thesis: Comparison is strongest when neither map is reduced to the other.
scenes.rationale: Full-system views prepare synthesis without premature blending.
scenes.risk: Too much information at thumbnail scale.
scenes.review_target: Keep one dominant axis on each side.

scenes.claim: Comparison can correct blind spots but must not claim simple equivalence.
scenes.topology: two systems held inside a red inference boundary
scenes.material_state: procession and mirror under caution frame
scenes.camera: halts before the maps merge
scenes.u_semantics: Correspondences increase while the outer limit remains fixed.
scenes.t_semantics: Each system continues moving independently inside the frame.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume reveals more internal detail, not more equivalence.
scenes.audio_beat_semantics: Beats pulse the boundary of inference.
scenes.glance_thesis: Mutual illumination does not authorize identity.
scenes.rationale: A persistent frame gives intellectual caution positive visual force.
scenes.risk: Caution may feel like an interruption.
scenes.review_target: Keep both inner systems alive and beautiful.

scenes.claim: Transcendent procession and immanent recognition can cross as complementary protections.
scenes.topology: vertical procession crossed by horizontal mirror
scenes.material_state: gold crossing of violet and cyan systems
scenes.camera: orbits the intersection without flattening axes
scenes.u_semantics: Independent axes meet and exchange light while retaining direction.
scenes.t_semantics: Vertical descent and horizontal reflection continue simultaneously.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume increases energy at the relation, not axis dominance.
scenes.glance_thesis: The maps can illuminate one another without becoming one map.
scenes.rationale: The cross is a relational operator, not a final doctrinal verdict.
scenes.risk: Cross geometry could acquire unintended religious symbolism.
scenes.review_target: Emphasize axes, flow, and mirror mechanics over emblem shape.

scenes.claim: Multiplicity can be read as dependent overflow or free self-display, and the unresolved difference remains philosophically productive.
scenes.topology: source, procession, mirror, weave, and encompassing field
scenes.camera: pulls back beyond both maps into their shared question field
scenes.u_semantics: All major optical laws become simultaneously legible within one boundary.
scenes.t_semantics: Descent, reflection, and difference retain distinct rhythms.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume increases relational coherence across the complete frame.
scenes.audio_beat_semantics: Beats send restrained pulses through both maps without clipping.
scenes.glance_thesis: Unity and multiplicity remain joined by two irreducible explanations.
scenes.rationale: The coda preserves productive disagreement as part of the whole.
scenes.risk: Layer density may erase the primary axes.
scenes.review_target: Vertical violet, horizontal cyan, and gold relation must remain readable.
